_what: The agreement between the VESTA Kiosk and the VESTA Agent (the /agent/v1 interface), declared ONCE. The Kiosk's proxy (rootfs/usr/bin/supervisor-proxy.py) checks against it, the app (src/agent/agentApi.ts) reads its lists, and the VESTA Agent host keeps a copy (agent-host/contract/agent-contract.json) that its CI compares with this file. tests/agent-interface.py replays the samples through the real proxy; tests/oracles/agent_view.mjs parses the sample view. A change a version-1 agent cannot survive is a new version, not an edit to this one.
_ticketUpdate: One step in a Facility fault's history (FmTicketUpdate in src/fm/fmTypes.ts; the VESTA Agent writes them through /agent/v1/fm-data). `kind` says what the step is, so neither side reads a note's first words: none = a status step (raised, picked up, resolved; `by` the profile that recorded it, `who` the name typed for who does the work); reopened = a resolved fault open again (`by` who reopened it); retitled = the VESTA Agent changed the title (`title` the new one, `was` the one before); reading = what the VESTA Agent reads now on a fault whose title a person changed (`title`): the person's title stays. A step the VESTA Agent writes carries `title` when it gives the fault one.
_answering: Who may press a message's buttons: every profile holding this capability in roles.json (never a guest).
